Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study employs a multi-pronged approach using mechanical strain (CTS), genetic knockdown (siRNA), and genetic overexpression (doxycycline-inducible) to investigate the role of SUN2 in nuclear decoupling. Proteomics was used to analyze total protein abundance, protein conformation (via mBBr labeling), and PTMs (phosphorylation and oxidation).
